sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Decorative Films Design Studio manufactures custom architectural films and glass films designed and made to order with capabilities up to 71 inches with no seams.

Industry: Building Materials Manufacturing · Size: <$50M · Products: Custom Architectural Films, Decorative Glass Films, Gradients, Murals, Repeatable Patterns, Architectural Wall Covering

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Decorative Films Design Studio scores 17 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. Nothing was found for industry fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (53% similar on films, architectural, color, window); Mactac (39% similar on films, film, digital, graphic); ORAFOL Europe (39% similar on films, digital, graphic, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
